definitions.name: Dwarf
definitions.shortDescription: Dwarves are hardy humanoids whose traits emphasize resilience and a bond with stone.
definitions.fullDescription: The dwarf species entry defines size, speed, darkvision, resilience against poison, and the Stonecunning trait. Individual characters reference this stable definition rather than copying its rules text.

definitions.name: Wizard
definitions.shortDescription: A Wizard studies arcane magic and prepares spells from a spellbook.
definitions.fullDescription: Wizard progression uses Intelligence, a d6 Hit Point Die, prepared spellcasting, and a spellbook. Features and the Evoker subclass are represented by related definitions.
definitions.searchText: wizard intelligence spellbook prepared arcane magic

typedContent.spellcasting: Prepared arcane spells from a spellbook

definitions.name: Cure Wounds
definitions.shortDescription: Restorative magic heals a creature you touch.
definitions.fullDescription: A creature touched by the caster regains hit points. Casting the spell with a higher-level slot increases the amount restored.
definitions.searchText: healing touch hit points higher level

definitions.name: Fireball
definitions.shortDescription: A mote of fire erupts at a point in range and engulfs nearby creatures in flame.
definitions.fullDescription: Each creature in the spell area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. The damage increases when the spell is cast with a higher-level slot.
definitions.searchText: explosion sphere dexterity save fire damage higher level

definitions.name: Longsword
definitions.shortDescription: A versatile martial melee weapon that deals slashing damage.
definitions.fullDescription: A longsword deals 1d8 Slashing damage in one hand or 1d10 when used with two hands through the Versatile property. Its 2024 mastery property is Sap.
definitions.searchText: longsword martial melee versatile sap slashing

definitions.name: Chain Mail
definitions.shortDescription: Heavy armor made from interlocking metal rings.
definitions.fullDescription: Chain Mail sets base Armor Class to 16. A wearer below Strength 13 has reduced speed, and the armor imposes Disadvantage on Stealth checks.
definitions.searchText: chain mail heavy armor strength stealth

definitions.name: Concentration
definitions.shortDescription: Concentration governs how a creature maintains certain spells and effects.
definitions.fullDescription: A creature can concentrate on only one effect at a time. Taking damage can require a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration, and several other events can end it.
definitions.searchText: concentration constitution saving throw damage spell effect
